episode_title: The Birth of the Quantum, Planck 1900
description: This episode explores Max Planck's 1900 paper that accidentally birthed quantum mechanics by solving the black body radiation problem. It's essential for anyone wanting to understand how the quantum revolution began—not from bold theory, but from a reluctant mathematical fix to explain why hot objects glow specific colors, leading to the radical discovery that energy comes in discrete packets rather than continuous flows.
